natural: Hiding one's illness and avoiding the doctor

meaning.en: To hide one's faults and refuse help.
meaning.zh: 隐瞒疾病，不愿医治。比喻怕人批评而掩饰自己的缺点和错误。

equivalents: bury one's head in the sand
refuse to face up to problems

examples.zh: 有问题要及时解决，不能讳疾忌医。
examples.en: Deal with problems promptly — don't be in denial.

examples.zh: 他讳疾忌医，小病拖成了大病。
examples.en: He avoided the doctor, and a minor illness became serious.

story.en: The physician Bian Que warned Duke Huan of Cai three times that his illness was spreading deeper; the duke insisted he was well and died. Zhou Dunyi later wrote of people who "guard their illness and shun the doctor" (护疾而忌医).
story.zh: 扁鹊三次劝蔡桓公治病，桓公不听，终至病死。周敦颐《通书》："今人有过，不喜人规，如护疾而忌医。"

date.en: end of Warring States, 3rd c. BC

natural: Letting words flow like a river

meaning.en: To talk irresponsibly; to shoot one's mouth off.
meaning.zh: 比喻随口乱说一气。

equivalents: make things up as one goes along

examples.zh: 没有根据的话不要信口开河。
examples.en: Don't shoot your mouth off without evidence.

examples.zh: 他信口开河，说自己认识很多明星。
examples.en: He talked through his hat, claiming to know lots of celebrities.

antonyms: 没有调查就没有发言权

meaning.en: Evenly matched.
meaning.zh: 比喻双方力量不相上下。

examples.zh: 两位棋手旗鼓相当，下了五个小时还没分胜负。
examples.en: The two players were evenly matched — after five hours there was still no winner.

examples.zh: 这两家公司实力旗鼓相当。
examples.en: The two companies are well matched.

synonyms: 一个半斤，一个八两——彼此一样
一个半斤，一个八两——没什么两样
antonyms: 戴着斗笠亲嘴——差一大截
小拇指比大腿——差一大截

meaning.en: A priceless treasure.
meaning.zh: 无法估价的宝物。指极珍贵的东西。

examples.zh: 健康是无价之宝。
examples.en: Health is priceless.

examples.zh: 这些老照片对我来说是无价之宝。
examples.en: These old photos are priceless to me.

natural: Enduring humiliation and bearing a heavy load

meaning.en: To endure humiliation for the sake of an important mission.
meaning.zh: 为了完成艰巨的任务，忍受屈辱，承担重任。

examples.zh: 他忍辱负重，终于完成了使命。
examples.en: Swallowing his pride, he finally completed his mission.

examples.zh: 为了家庭，她忍辱负重多年。
examples.en: For her family's sake, she endured years of humiliation.

story.en: Sun Quan explained why he chose the young Lu Xun as commander over veteran generals: "because he can endure humiliation and bear a heavy burden" (以其能忍辱负重故也). Lu Xun went on to defeat Liu Bei at Yiling.
story.zh: 孙权说重用陆逊"以其能忍辱负重故也"。陆逊后在夷陵大败刘备。

meaning.en: Good governance and a harmonious populace.
meaning.zh: 政事顺利，人心和顺。形容国泰民安。

examples.zh: 这个地方政通人和，经济发展很快。
examples.en: The area is well governed and harmonious, and its economy is growing fast.

examples.zh: 只有政通人和，才能百业兴旺。
examples.en: Only with good governance and harmony can all industries flourish.

story.en: Fan Zhongyan wrote that after a year of Teng Zijing's administration, "government ran smoothly and people were harmonious; all neglected things were revived" (政通人和，百废具兴).
story.zh: 范仲淹《岳阳楼记》："越明年，政通人和，百废具兴。"

meaning.en: Justice is inescapable; heaven's net catches all wrongdoers.
meaning.zh: 天道像一个广阔的大网，作恶的人终究逃不脱惩罚。

equivalents: the long arm of the law

examples.zh: 天网恢恢，疏而不漏，逃犯最终落网。
examples.en: Justice will out — the fugitive was finally caught.

examples.zh: 天网恢恢，作恶的人一定会受到惩罚。
examples.en: Heaven's net is vast — evildoers will surely be punished.

story.en: Laozi: "Heaven's net is vast; though its mesh is wide, nothing slips through" (天网恢恢，疏而不失).

date.zh: 春秋末至战国 · 前6—前4世纪
date.en: late Spring and Autumn to Warring States, 6th–4th c. BC

usage.en: Usually in the full saying with 疏而不漏.

synonyms: 若要人不知，除非己莫为

meaning.en: Selfish; caring only about oneself.
meaning.zh: 只为自己打算，只图自己的利益。

examples.zh: 他太自私自利了，从不帮助别人。
examples.en: He's so selfish he never helps anyone.

examples.zh: 自私自利的人很难交到真朋友。
examples.en: Selfish people find it hard to make real friends.

antonyms: 先天下之忧而忧，后天下之乐而乐

natural: Painting the dragon and dotting in its eyes

meaning.en: The finishing touch that brings something to life.
meaning.zh: 比喻写文章或讲话时，在关键地方用几句话点明实质，使内容更加生动有力。

examples.zh: 这句话在文章结尾起到了画龙点睛的作用。
examples.en: This sentence provides the finishing touch at the end of the essay.

examples.zh: 一条红围巾给整套衣服画龙点睛。
examples.en: A red scarf was the finishing touch to the outfit.

story.en: The painter Zhang Sengyou painted four dragons on a temple wall without eyes, saying they would fly away if he added them. Mocked, he dotted the eyes of two — thunder struck and those two flew off into the sky.
story.zh: 张僧繇在寺壁画了四条龙不点眼睛，说点了就会飞走。众人不信，他点了两条，顿时雷电大作，两龙乘云飞去。

usage.en: Often 起到画龙点睛的作用 (provides the finishing touch).
usage.zh: 常用"起到画龙点睛的作用"。

natural: Going with the current and joining the filth

meaning.en: To associate with bad people and join in their wrongdoing.
meaning.zh: 随着坏人一起干坏事。

equivalents: fall in with a bad crowd
be tarred with the same brush

examples.zh: 他坚决不与贪官同流合污。
examples.en: He firmly refused to get his hands dirty with corrupt officials.

examples.zh: 在那种环境下不同流合污很难。
examples.en: In that environment it's hard not to be drawn in.

story.en: Mencius describes the hypocrite who "goes along with vulgar customs and joins the filthy world" (同乎流俗，合乎污世) while appearing virtuous.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，常用"与……同流合污"。

meaning.en: Worthless; not worth a penny.
meaning.zh: 连一文钱也不值。形容毫无价值。

equivalents: not worth the paper it's written on

examples.zh: 在他眼里，我的努力一文不值。
examples.en: In his eyes, my efforts are worthless.

examples.zh: 这张股票现在一文不值。
examples.en: This share certificate is now worthless.

usage.en: Predicate. Often 被说得一文不值 (run down completely).

meaning.en: Continuous; stretching on without a break.
meaning.zh: 连续不断。

examples.zh: 窗外是连绵不断的群山。
examples.en: Outside the window, mountains stretch on endlessly.

examples.zh: 这几天阴雨连绵不断。
examples.en: It's been raining non-stop for days.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. Mountains, rain, history.

natural: Penetrating three-tenths of an inch into wood

meaning.en: Penetrating and incisive (of writing or analysis).
meaning.zh: 形容书法有力。比喻分析问题很深刻。

examples.zh: 这篇评论入木三分。
examples.en: The review is incisive.

examples.zh: 作者把人物性格刻画得入木三分。
examples.en: The author's portrayal of the characters is penetrating.

story.en: Wang Xizhi once wrote on a wooden board for a sacrifice. When carvers later planed it, they found the ink had soaked three fen (about a centimetre) deep into the wood.
story.zh: 王羲之在木板上写字，刻工削木时发现墨迹渗入木中三分深。

usage.en: Predicate or complement (刻画得入木三分).

synonyms: 写鬼写妖高人一等，刺贪刺虐入骨三分

meaning.en: To live an undistinguished life with no achievements.
meaning.zh: 平平庸庸，无所作为。

examples.zh: 我不想碌碌无为地过一辈子。
examples.en: I don't want to fritter my life away.

examples.zh: 他虚度年华，碌碌无为。
examples.en: He wasted his years and achieved nothing.

meaning.en: Surviving a disaster; life after a catastrophe.
meaning.zh: 经历灾难后侥幸保存下来的生命。

examples.zh: 地震中劫后余生的人们更加珍惜生活。
examples.en: People who survived the earthquake treasure life all the more.

examples.zh: 经历了那场车祸，他有一种劫后余生的感觉。
examples.en: After the car crash, he felt lucky to be alive.

meaning.en: With rhythmic rise and fall (of voice or music); well modulated.
meaning.zh: 指声音的高低起伏和停顿转折，和谐而有节奏。

examples.zh: 他朗读得抑扬顿挫，非常有感情。
examples.en: He read aloud with lovely cadence and feeling.

examples.zh: 老师讲课抑扬顿挫，学生们听得很入迷。
examples.en: The teacher's well-modulated delivery held the students spellbound.

meaning.en: Selfless and impartial.
meaning.zh: 指办事公正，没有私心。

examples.zh: 他大公无私，深受群众爱戴。
examples.en: He's selfless and impartial, and much loved by the people.

examples.zh: 处理问题要大公无私。
examples.en: Handle problems impartially.

synonyms: 先天下之忧而忧，后天下之乐而乐

meaning.en: Clear, precise pronunciation and a full, rounded voice.
meaning.zh: 形容吐字准确，唱腔圆润。也形容说话发音准确清楚。

examples.zh: 播音员字正腔圆，普通话非常标准。
examples.en: The announcer's diction is perfect, with flawless Mandarin.

examples.zh: 这位京剧演员唱得字正腔圆。
examples.en: The Peking opera singer's voice is clear and resonant.

meaning.en: To prevent trouble before it occurs.
meaning.zh: 在事故或灾害尚未发生之前就加以预防。

examples.zh: 定期检查身体，防患未然。
examples.en: Get regular check-ups — prevention is better than cure.

examples.zh: 消防演习就是为了防患未然。
examples.en: Fire drills are about preventing trouble before it happens.

story.en: The Book of Changes: "The gentleman thinks of trouble and guards against it in advance" (君子以思患而豫防之).
story.zh: 《周易·既济》："君子以思患而豫防之。"

date.zh: 西周至战国 · 前9—前3世纪
date.en: Western Zhou to Warring States, 9th–3rd c. BC

usage.zh: 多作谓语。也作"防患于未然"。

synonyms: 宁可信其有，不可信其无
antonyms: 贼去了才关门——错过时机
是福不是祸，是祸躲不过

natural: Nine chances of death to one of life

meaning.en: A narrow escape from great danger.
meaning.zh: 形容经历极大危险而幸存。

equivalents: by the skin of one's teeth

examples.zh: 他在战场上九死一生。
examples.en: He narrowly escaped death on the battlefield.

examples.zh: 探险队九死一生，终于走出了沙漠。
examples.en: The expedition escaped by the skin of their teeth and finally got out of the desert.

story.en: Qu Yuan: "Even if I die nine times, I will not regret it" (虽九死其犹未悔). Later commentators expanded the image into nine deaths to one survival.
story.zh: 屈原《离骚》："亦余心之所善兮，虽九死其犹未悔。"

natural: The medicine arrives and the illness goes

meaning.en: An instant cure; a fix that works immediately.
meaning.zh: 药一吃下去病就好了。形容医术高明或方法得当，问题很快解决。

examples.zh: 这位老中医医术高明，药到病除。
examples.en: The old Chinese doctor is so skilled his remedies work instantly.

examples.zh: 这个方法药到病除，问题马上解决了。
examples.en: The method worked like magic and the problem was solved at once.

antonyms: 病来如山倒，病去如抽丝

natural: Lively as a dragon or tiger

meaning.en: Full of vigour and energy.
meaning.zh: 形容活泼矫健，富有生气。

examples.zh: 病好了以后，他又生龙活虎了。
examples.en: Now that he's better, he's full of beans again.

examples.zh: 操场上的孩子们一个个生龙活虎。
examples.en: The children in the playground are bursting with energy.

meaning.en: Sincerely convinced; to accept wholeheartedly.
meaning.zh: 诚心诚意地服从或佩服。

examples.zh: 他的分析让大家心悦诚服。
examples.en: His analysis won everyone over completely.

examples.zh: 输给这样的对手，我心悦诚服。
examples.en: Losing to an opponent like that, I accept it wholeheartedly.

story.en: Mencius: "Those who subdue others by force do not win hearts; those who subdue others by virtue are gladly and sincerely followed" (以德服人者，中心悦而诚服也).
story.zh: 《孟子》："以力服人者，非心服也；以德服人者，中心悦而诚服也。"

meaning.en: Effort brings rewards in time; also outward grace and inner substance.
meaning.zh: 春天开花，秋天结果。比喻付出劳动就有收获，也比喻文采和德行。

examples.zh: 春华秋实，十年寒窗终于换来了好成绩。
examples.en: Hard work pays off — ten years of study finally brought excellent results.

examples.zh: 这本书记录了学校五十年的春华秋实。
examples.en: The book records the school's fifty years of growth and achievement.

usage.zh: 多作主语、宾语或单独成句。

natural: Hunger and cold pressing at once

meaning.en: Cold and hungry; destitute.
meaning.zh: 又饿又冷，形容生活极其贫困。

examples.zh: 旧社会，很多穷人饥寒交迫。
examples.en: In the old society, many poor people were cold and starving.

examples.zh: 救援队找到了饥寒交迫的登山者。
examples.en: The rescue team found the climbers cold and hungry.
